title: Deadline calendar and removal analysis from a served complaint

traps.title: LLC citizenship by state of formation / HQ
traps.why_wrong: LLC takes each member's citizenship (*Johnson*, *Carden*); the Seattle partner is a member → WA vs WA → no diversity; also §1441(b)(2). Pushback repeats the friend's corporate test
traps.evidence: Cover email ('partner up in Seattle'); client script confirms member; library case entry
traps.harm: Removal → remand with fees under §1447(c); months lost; state deadline possibly blown meanwhile

traps.title: Adding 3 days for mail
traps.why_wrong: Rule 6(d)/CR 6(e) apply to service of later papers under Rule 5/CR 5, not to Rule 4/CR 4 service of the summons; the declaration shows personal service

traps.title: Wrong calendar for the removal clock
traps.wrong_move: Day 30 = 2026-10-11 (Sunday) → Monday 2026-10-12; but Monday is Columbus Day, a FEDERAL legal holiday (6(a)(6)(A)) even though WA state courts are open → 2026-10-13
traps.evidence: If removal were available, a notice filed Tuesday would be timely — knowing that matters; and conversely a state deadline on a federal holiday does not roll

traps.title: Treating 'today' as the start
traps.why_wrong: Clock runs from service on the registered agent (receipt 'through service or otherwise')

oracle.tolerance: exact (even though removal is unavailable, the computed clock must be right)

oracle.expected: 2026-10-20 (assuming notice filed on the removal deadline; accept any correct 81(c)(2) computation for the stated assumed filing date)
